title: FinRL: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Library for Automated Stock Trading in Quantitative Finance

task.value: A beginner-friendly deep reinforcement learning library for developing and backtesting automated stock trading strategies (single stock, multiple stock trading, portfolio allocation).
task.quote: In this paper, we introduce a DRL library FinRL that facilitates beginners to expose themselves to quantitative finance and to develop their own stock trading strategies.

architecture.value: Three layers: Gym-based market environment (MDP with state, action, reward), DRL agent layer with fine-tuned algorithms, and application layer; lower layers provide APIs to upper layers.
architecture.quote: Three-layer architecture: The three layers of FinRL library are stock market environment, DRL trading agent, and stock trading applications. The agent layer interacts with the environment layer in an exploration-exploitation manner

data.value: Historical data from NASDAQ-100, DJIA, S&P 500, SSE 50, CSI 300, HSI; OHLCV and technical indicators at daily, hourly or minute frequency. Demos use SPY, QQQ, GOOGL, AMZN, AAPL, MSFT and Dow Jones 30 constituents.
data.quote: FinRL provides six environments based on representative listings, including NASDAQ-100, DJIA, S&P 500, SSE 50, CSI 300, and HSI, plus one user-defined environment.

window.value: Reported test results cover 2019/01/01-2020/09/23; training/validation split dates not given in text.

models.value: DRL algorithms DQN, DDPG, Multi-Agent DDPG, PPO, SAC, A2C, TD3, based on OpenAI Baselines and Stable Baselines; PPO used for single stock, DDPG and TD3 for multiple stock/portfolio.
models.quote: FinRL library includes fine-tuned standard DRL algorithms, namely, DQN [29][34], DDPG [29], Multi-Agent DDPG [30], PPO [40], SAC [18], A2C [33] and TD3 [11].

baselines.value: Buy-and-hold, mean-variance, min-variance, momentum, equal-weighted strategies; in demos, S&P 500 index, DJIA index and min-variance allocation.
baselines.quote: FinRL uses five conventional strategies, namely passive buy-and-hold trading strategy [32], mean-variance strategy [1], and min-variance strategy [1], momentum trading strategy [15], and equal-weighted strategy

headline_result.value: Over 2019/01/01-2020/09/23 on DJIA constituents, TD3 Sharpe ratio 1.38; 1.03 and DDPG 1.28; 0.98 versus Min-Var. 0.44 and DJIA 0.48.

costs.value: Transaction costs as a parameter: flat fee or per-share percentage (e.g., 1/1000 or 2/1000); bid-ask spread can be added to closing price.
costs.quote: Per share percentage: a per share rate for every share traded, for example, 1/1000 or 2/1000 are the most commonly used transaction cost rate for each trade.

leakage_controls.value: Training-validation-testing split, with testing data held out for unbiased evaluation; rolling window retraining supported.
leakage_controls.quote: Testing (trading) dataset is the sample of data to provide an unbiased evaluation of a fine-tuned model.

limitations.value: Authors note large maximum drawdowns in single-stock results due to the Covid-19 market crash.
limitations.quote: The maximum drawdown in Table 1 is large due to Covid-19 market crash.

release.value: Library to be released on GitHub.
release.quote: The FinRL library will be available on Github at link https://github.com/AI4Finance-LLC/FinRL-Library.
